backoff.statLabel: max possible delay before this attempt (ms)
backoff.note: Full jitter picks a delay uniformly between 0 and this cap, not the cap itself, so two callers hitting the same limit at the same time don't retry at the same moment.

thunder.note: Fixed delay: every caller computes the same backoff value, so they all land in one bucket, a synchronized spike hitting the already-struggling shipping API at once. Full jitter: each caller picks independently from 0-1600ms, spreading the same number of retries across every bucket instead.
